newsitem.title: FRANCE: Suspected French youth prostitution ring broken.
newsitem.headline: Suspected French youth prostitution ring broken.

text.p: Police have broken up a suspected prostitution ring run by a mathematics teacher and offering teenage boys for sex via France's Minitel telephone computer network, justice sources said on Wednesday.
The 46-year-old teacher and an alleged associate, a 47-year-old trader, were placed under formal investigation early this month suspected of pimping. Neither was named.
Investigators accuse the teacher of advertising boys of 16 or 17 years on the nationwide Minitel telephone database and letting clients have sex with them at his central Paris flat.
